personality_one_liner: A calm, highly focused personal finance companion designed for lightning-fast two-tap expense logging and instant budget clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS padding and comfortable vertical rhythm with precise touch targets >= 44x44pt.

do's: Use frosted glass header and sticky bottom bar over scrolling content
Apply translucent surface tint on floating action buttons and modal sheets
dont's: Never apply blur to form inputs or body text regions
Never stack more than two glass layers simultaneously

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of today's total, monthly budget progress, category breakdown chart, and recent expense logs.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with botanical brand tone
states.empty: Clean illustration with message 'No expenses logged yet. Tap + to add your first expense!' and Add Expense CTA
states.error: Readable alert card with Retry button and local storage recovery fallback

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with app title and month badge, followed by a monthly budget progress card showing ₹15,000 limit vs spent, quick summary pills for Today and This Month, category breakdown visual chart, and a chronologically grouped recent transactions list with category icons and note previews.

screens.name: AddExpense
screens.purpose: Lightning-fast two-tap modal/screen to log an expense with amount, category selection, and optional note.

states.loading: Quick modal entry with pre-focused amount keypad
states.empty: Category selector ready with Groceries, Fuel, Electricity, Eating out, and Recharge chips
states.error: Inline validation banner if amount is missing or invalid

screens.layout: Bottom sheet or full-screen modal with large numeric amount input, horizontal/grid category chips with icons, optional note text input, and a sticky primary Save button with haptic feedback.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Detailed category-wise spending breakdown and budget utilization analysis.

states.loading: Centered skeleton bars for category distribution
states.empty: Empty state prompting at least one expense entry to generate charts
states.error: Standard error view with retry action

screens.layout: Scrollable stats view with monthly budget status, category progress bars with percentage indicators, and historical spending comparisons.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage monthly budget limit (default ₹15000), export/import data, and view local storage stats.

states.error: Error toast on storage read/write failure

screens.layout: Clean iOS grouped list with budget configuration stepper, data reset/export options, and app info.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure lightning-fast local storage persistence using AsyncStorage for zero login and 100% offline-first reliability. Keep all text in simple English. Maintain strict WCAG AA contrast, touch targets >= 44x44pt, and zero banned colors (no indigo, violet, purple, or navy). Pin the primary Add Expense action accessibly. Use Plus Jakarta Sans font pairing and iOS-native clean aesthetics.
